summary: Strive purchased 73 BTC during June 8-14, 2026, bringing total holdings to 19,105 BTC as of June 12, 2026; Class A common stock outstanding increased to 69,894,045 shares (plus 9,780,018 Class B), with SATA preferred shares unchanged at 7,513,907.

Class A common shares outstanding increased to 71,787,867 and SATA preferred shares outstanding increased to 7,829,502 as of June 18, 2026 (combined basic shares including Class B: 81,567,885).

As of June 26, 2026, BTC holdings are 19,864 (unchanged from prior period shown); Class A common shares outstanding increased to 71,864,809 (plus 9,780,018 Class B and 7,829,502 SATA preferred shares outstanding).

As of July 2, 2026, Strive held 19,882 BTC (up 17.76 from prior period); Class A common shares outstanding increased to 72,945,813, Class B remained at 9,780,018, and SATA shares remained at 7,829,502, with debt principal at zero as of June 30, 2026.

The model's BTC figure of 19,864 is stale by one weekly 8-K cycle: the July 6, 2026 8-K (primary SEC source) confirms 19,882 BTC as of July 2, 2026 (matching bitcointreasuries.net; CoinGecko's 19,000 is the June 1 figure and loses). Shares_basic of 82,725,831 (Class A 72,945,813 + Class B 9,780,018 as of July 2) is confirmed correct and unchanged from the current model. Debt_face is confirmed zero: the legacy Semler 4.25% convertible notes were fully retired May 12, 2026 and the July 6 8-K reaffirms zero debt at June 30, 2026, so converts correctly remains an empty list. Preferred liquidation preference is $782,950,200 (7,829,502 SATA shares × $100 stated amount), unchanged from the prior period; cash of $153.4M as of July 2 is newly sourced from the same 8-K.
